gameMaster.title: Game Master

lobby.admin: You are the game creator! You can change round time, difficulty, and points to win in the settings panel. When all teams are ready, click 'Start Game'!
lobby.player: Welcome to the lobby! Join a team. Once you're in a team, don't forget to click 'Ready'!
lobby.noTeams: To start the game, you need to divide into teams. There must be at least 2 teams.

pending.myTurnExplainer: You are explaining words in this round! Make sure you are ready, and click 'Ready'. You will have limited time.
pending.myTurnGuesser: Your team is playing! Your teammate will explain words to you. Get ready to guess and click 'Ready'.
pending.otherTurn: Another team is playing now. You can relax and listen. Waiting for them to get ready.

inProgress.myTurnExplainer: Fast! Explain the word on the screen! Use synonyms, descriptions, or gestures. Do not use root words! Press 🟢 for correct or 🔴 to skip.
inProgress.myTurnGuesser: Listen closely to your teammate! Guess words and say them out loud so they can mark it.
inProgress.otherTurn: Round in progress! Listen carefully to the opponents. If they break the rules, you can point it out!

pointing.admin: Time to verify answers! Click on words in the list to toggle status (correct/incorrect) if there was a mistake. When done, click 'End Pointing'.
pointing.player: Pointing is in progress. The host is reviewing the round answers. Next round starts soon!

finished.admin: Round finished! Check out the results. Click 'Next Round' when everyone is ready to continue.
finished.player: Round finished! Review the results and get ready for the next round.

gameMaster.gameFinished: Game finished! Great match! Congratulations to the winners 🎉. You can go back to the game list or start a new lobby.
